scenario: coaching institute admission for a class 11 student (parent on call)

seller.product: Two-year JEE classroom programme for class 11-12
price_list: DSAT scholarship test: up to 20% off
Bus service ₹1,200 per month (free only for scholarship students)
Foundation course class 8-10, weekend batch, ₹42,000 per year

speakers.name: Shweta Raghuvanshi
speakers.style: senior counsellor, warm but pushy, defensive about competitor, talks fast

speakers.name: Rajesh Bhardwaj
speakers.style: father of the student, polite, a little apologetic, practical about money and distance

coaching_truths.statement: At the first counselling nobody asked the school timing; the morning-only batch clashed with school and became a main reason for the loss. The counsellor admitted it.
The counsellor badmouthed the competitor's faculty; the father pushed back with a teacher who left her own institute, which hurt her credibility.
She said the bus was free this year, then corrected it: free only for scholarship students, ₹1,200 a month for everyone else.
She cut in to defend the faculty while the father was listing his reasons; he had to ask her to let him finish.
When the father asked about a foundation course for his younger daughter, she steered back to re-selling Aarav and had to be told again.
She accepted the loss gracefully and set a concrete end-of-March follow-up for the daughter, keeping the family warm.
